verdict.rationale: Sentry's own alerting docs state that alerts can call webhooks when issues match rules, so the product directly provides alert-to-webhook delivery that an external remediation system or agent could receive. That support is only a single-line mention, with no documentation of webhook registration, payload schema, signing or retries, or end-to-end automated remediation. Seer Autofix and launching Cursor agents are separate features and earn no credit for webhook-triggered remediation. missing for 10: documented webhook registration and configuration, payload schema and security (signing/verification), retry/delivery guarantees, an example of webhook-triggered agent or remediation workflows, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents

citations.quote: Sentry's Alerts take action when issues in your organization match pre-defined rules. An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations
An alert can send notifications, create tickets, call webhooks, or use other integrations for issues coming from projects or Monitors.
